lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular passive imperfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يُصْهَرُ is in the derivative form: يُصْهَر
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ص/هـ/ر   ṣ–h–r to melt down, to heat up, to roast; to bring near; to marry into (a family), in-laws.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
يُصْهَر yuṣhar and صِهْر ṣihr.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يُصْهَر yuṣhar [pass. imperf. v.] to be melted down, to be scorched

(22:20) يُصْهَرُ بِهِ مَا فِى بُطُونِهِمْ وَالْجُلُودُ what is in their insides as well as their skins will be melted by it.

entries.label: صِهْر
entries.definitionHtml:
صِهْر ṣihr [n./quasi-act. part.] an in-law/being related through marriage

(25:54) وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا and He it is who created from water a human being, then made him kin by blood and by marriage.
